d: Sal 2026 ke jun men mahine men dilli men huaa sijepi ka protest ek tarah se bharat men yuvaon ki bhagidari ke lie bhi charcha men raha. us virodh pradarshan men tatkalin shiksha mantri dharmendr pradhan ke istife ki mang pramukh thi. ye mang ek aisi sarkar ke samne rakhi ja rahi thi, jiske mantri pahle kah chuke the ki unki sarkaron men istife nahin hote. lekin virodh pradarshan ka dayra barhta gaya aur aakhirkar dharmendr pradhan ne apne pad se istifa diya. iske kuchh mahine bad ek bar phir sijepi ne mukhy chunav aayukt gyanesh kumar ke istife ki mang ko lekar dilli samet desh ke…
